note: Within-date agreement and spatially clustered intervals for the Gaocheng designs. Within-date RMSE measures error after removing each date's mean bias; it does not measure whether plots are ranked correctly. This script adds within-date R2 (bias removed), Spearman rho, the ratio of predicted to observed SD, recall of the lowest 20% of plots and overlap of the highest 20%. Intervals resample 40 m spatial blocks with replacement inside each date, so plots that share a block stay together. Method differences use the same resampled blocks for both methods. 6 June is reported but excluded from the within-date means because its LCC range is about 2 ug cm-2. The random-order reference band for the risk-coverage curves (script 35) is also computed here from repeated random retention orders.
